cancel_metadata.detail:
CANCELLED AT P1-T1 (READ), before any edit. The stub's premise was that INDEX.md and RELATIONSHIPS.md fail to stamp documents: through oversight, because they are 'fully mechanical so a documents: claim is assertable'. Reading the generators refutes that. BOTH already carry an explicit, reasoned refusal in source:
  generate-index-md.js:47-49  — 'related_files (NOT documents): INDEX is a repo-wide registry — claiming it "documents" specific files would be an invented per-file claim.'
  generate-relationships-md.js:62-64 — 'related_files (NOT documents): repo-wide dependency overview — the most-referenced files it displays are related context, not per-file documentation claims.'
MECHANICAL != DOCUMENTING. A doc projected from the index is not thereby a doc that governs specific files. EXPORTS and HOTSPOTS make genuine per-file claims (export-bearing files; hotspot files); INDEX and RELATIONSHIPS are repo-wide overviews and a documents: list for them would be fabricated coverage — precisely the failure the doc lane exists to prevent.
CONCLUSION: foundation-doc documents-edge coverage of 2/8 is CORRECT BY DESIGN, not a gap. All six unbound docs are deliberately unbound: 4 hand-authored (enhance-existing-docs.js refuses on the same grounds) + these 2 repo-wide overviews. Executing this WO would have REGRESSED the doc lane by minting invented claims.
